recognitionRules: Use Chalkboard activity titles and large card numbers, with Trebuchet instructions and teal practice labels.
Give each card one activity with materials and an action prompt.
Use symbols only when accompanied by a readable label.
Keep enough open space for a learner’s own pattern or explanation.
Use teal activity labels and pattern symbols; retain handwritten Chalkboard titles above practical Trebuchet instructions.

writingLinks.name: Socratic exchange
writingLinks.reason: Learners test rules on changed inputs and get feedback, which refines their understanding.

quote: Find the rule. Try it another way. Tell someone what you noticed.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use PATTERN PRACTICE in Trebuchet with a three-unit repeating mark whose last unit is open. Avoid a puzzle-piece symbol.
invariants: Use Chalkboard activity titles and large card numbers, with Trebuchet instructions and teal practice labels.
Give each card one activity with materials and an action prompt.
Use symbols only when accompanied by a readable label.
adaptations: Large-format cards support group use; small cards retain the same reading order.
New activities may change the pattern while keeping the prompt structure.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
